note: EXTRA biome kit (Frostspire snow, Mirefen swamp, rail station, flood). Same schema as tileset.json. ids start at 5001 and names start with "x_" so this file can be merged without clashes; see EXTRA_TILES.md. 2x nearest-neighbour copy of tileset_extra.json.

collision_notes.deep_water: NEW (11): water that needs Dive/strong Surf

draw_order: characters + ysort overlay tiles, sorted by tile row (character first on ties)
fog (NEW optional layer; x_fog_* tiles; clearable)

tiles.name: x_snow_0
tiles.notes: Frostspire powder snow (replaces the pinkish base snow_* in Frostspire maps)

tiles.name: x_ice_0
tiles.notes: ice-slide floor: collision "ice" (walkable; player slides until blocked)

tiles.name: x_mud_0
tiles.notes: Mirefen peat mud (darker/wetter than base mud_*)

tiles.name: x_moss_0
tiles.notes: Mirefen moss ground (swamp grass base)

tiles.name: x_grass_0
tiles.notes: COPY of base grass_<v> (same recipe/seed) so snow edges can be previewed standalone; remap to grass_<v> on merge

tiles.name: x_path_0
tiles.notes: COPY of base path_<v>; remap to path_<v> on merge

tiles.name: x_bog
tiles.notes: Mirefen bog water: surf-able like water (collision water); 3-frame swell

tiles.name: x_water
tiles.notes: COPY of base water; remap to water on merge

tiles.name: x_deep_water
tiles.notes: deep water: collision "deep_water" (needs Dive/strong Surf; matches base water wave phase)

tiles.name: x_flood
tiles.notes: flooded path: shallow water over cobbles, walkable (splash fx / no encounters by default)

tiles.notes: Rock Smash-able candidate (block)

tiles.name: x_reeds
tiles.notes: reed clump on land/mud (block)

tiles.name: x_reeds_water
tiles.notes: reeds standing in bog water (surf-blocking scenery: collision water)

tiles.notes: narrow plank: bike only (same rule as base bike_rail_*)

tiles.name: x_dead_tree_0_0
tiles.notes: 1x2 dead swamp tree: row 0 overlay, row 1 trunk (block)

tiles.name: x_fog_0000_q0
tiles.notes: Mirefen fog (clearable, e.g. by Defog): drawn in its own top "fog" layer above overlay. <NESW>=1 means that side borders clear air; q = (x%2)+2*(y%2)

tiles.name: x_station_0_0
tiles.notes: Revival-era rail station 7x5. Door = x_station_4_3 (collision door). Name band + clock face left blank for later text

tiles.name: x_rail_h_out
tiles.notes: outdoor track on ballast (block)

tiles.name: x_rail_buffer

tiles.name: x_platform_edge_s
tiles.notes: platform edge; tracks are SOUTH of it

tiles.name: x_rail_h
tiles.notes: indoor track bed (block)

tiles.name: x_ticket_counter_l
tiles.notes: ticket counter (l/m/r); talk across it to the clerk standing behind
